filing_office: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services
filing_fee_notes: Current Treasury fee schedule and registration instructions, updated July 1, 2026, list 100 for a for-profit formation.
registered_agent_rules: Provide a registered agent and a New Jersey street address for the registered office. A P.O. box may accompany, but cannot replace, the street address.
expedite_options: The LLC schedule lists additional fees of 25 for over-the-counter expedited service, 50 for same-day fax service, 500 for two-hour service and 1000 for one-hour service; channel restrictions apply.
annual_report_due: Annually in the formation anniversary month.
state_tax_registration_agency: New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services
unemployment_insurance_agency: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Division of Employer Accounts
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Formation, then complete NJ-REG for tax and employer registration. File an annual report in the anniversary month.
common_mistake: Do not stop after forming the LLC; NJ-REG is a separate registration.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. The due field uses the anniversary-month wording confirmed in Treasury's registration packet; the exact day was not confirmed from the permitted filing-office or revenue sources. Standard processing time, franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
